in_hebrew.name: Merilyn
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Merilyn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English elements meru ('mercy') and hlinan ('to hide, protect'). Merilyn may symbolize a compassionate and protective woman, like a mother lion safeguarding her cubs.

in_greek.name: Merilyn
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Merciful lynx
in_greek.long_meaning: Merilyn είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Old English elements meru ('mercy') and hlinan ('to hide, protect'). Merilyn may symbolize a compassionate and protective woman, like a mother lion safeguarding her cubs.

in_latin.name: Merilyn
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Merciful lynx
in_latin.long_meaning: Merilyn est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Old English elements meru ('mercy') and hlinan ('to hide, protect'). Merilyn may symbolize a compassionate and protective woman, like a mother lion safeguarding her cubs.
